prose: Bloomberg reports Samsung unveiled the $229 Galaxy Buds On, its first open-fit, C-shaped cuff earbuds, competing with Sony and Bose in a growing category. The earbuds were designed with AI's help and ship November 6.
highlights: Galaxy Buds On: $229 open-fit cuff earbuds
Samsung's first entry in the cuff category vs Sony and Bose
Designed with AI assistance; ships November 6
